name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A searchable select: the select field opens a panel with a search row and the select's rows; several values show as chips.
usage: Choose from a list too long to scan (organizations, domains, API keys, countries) or where typing is faster. Use ComboboxTrigger with ComboboxValue for one value, ComboboxChips with ComboboxChip and ComboboxChipsInput for several; give a name to submit the values with the form.
avoid: A combobox for fewer than seven options (use Select)
Losing the typed search on a pick in multiple mode
